## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Tech leadership visible with XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) while fear is receding: VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ↑ rising, providing two independent confirmations.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Stocks vs bonds confirming risk-on: Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT) (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +8.01%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, though credit stress is picking up: Credit Spread (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.53%) → flat ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing: Dollar UUP proxy weaker (Dollar Strength 1W: -0.07% | 1M: -0.80%) → flat BELOW TREND while yield curve in RECOVERY (1W: +0.16% | 1M: -0.56%) → flat and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53%) — conditions accommodative for risk.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech and cyclicals leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) and XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +10.92%) while Energy lagging: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%). Style: Growth/momentum showing strength, supported by sector breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US strong: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%); EM outperforming on a relative basis: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +10.56%) and China FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +3.87%). Europe softer on a relative correction vs US.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows elevated: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.35% | 1M: +10.95%), IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +9.14%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +12.10%) — speculation rising.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial metals strong: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%) and gold GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +0.27%) showing safe-haven and cyclical demand support. Overall commodity mix is uneven with oil underperforming.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%). Natural gas mixed in RECOVERY: UNG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%) RECOVERY — watch seasonal and supply signals.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Broad leadership in Tech and Small caps with XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +12.10%). Minor divergences: XLB in CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +7.49%) and UNG in RECOVERY (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%) — monitor commodity signal shifts.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to growth/momentum and cyclicals given broad breadth and risk-on signals (e.g., XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +10.92%)). Reduce exposure to energy beta and commodity-sensitive defensives while watching credit spread dynamics.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) and Semis SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%). BEARISH: Energy XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) and Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -1.47%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%). BEARISH: Oil BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) and broader energy complex weakness to monitor.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency trigger) given VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) ↓ falling; HYG/LQD spread ~0.80 (credit health) as Credit Spread (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.53%) → flat ABOVE TREND; XLK/XLF ratio ~2.94 (sector leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and small caps showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%), IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +12.10%)).  
Key risk is rising credit stress (Credit Spread 1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.53% → flat ABOVE TREND) — monitor HYG/LQD and oil weakness for early cracks.
